messages.author: 81b6b3d7dfea88a5
messages.subject: populating UI selectInput(choices=) from server result ?
parts:
Firstly shiny is fantastic (thanks), but of course we always want it to do more !

I don't know javascript so apologies if I've missed something obvious.

I want to populate a selectInput() choice box with results from server, and have been trying for a day with no success. I've created a toy example in which you'll see I abandoned an initially logical approach and tried brute force with various failed trials commented out.

Any hints appreciated.
Thanks,
Andy

UI.r
library(shiny)

# Define UI 
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
  # Application title
  h5("to test populating UI selectInput from server result, Andy South, 17/01/2013"),
  
  # Sidebar with controls 
  sidebarPanel(
    
    sliderInput("numSpSelected", "Top X species", 
                min = 1, max = 6, value = 2, step= 1)
       
    ,selectInput("variable", "Choose a species : (I want the number of species to be defined by the slider above)"
                 #,choices = output.getSelectedSpecies) #fails: object 'output.getSelectedSpecies' not found
                 #,choices = getSelectedSpecies) #fails: object 'getSelectedSpecies' not found
                 ,choices = "getSelectedSpecies") #populates box with the text "getSelectedSpecies"
                 #,choices = output$getSelectedSpecies) #fails: object 'output' not found
                 #,choices = output.speciesSubset)# fails:
                 #,choices = output.speciesSubset())# fails:could not find function "output.speciesSubset"

    #this used to get a list of selected species into the UI, now seems not to 
    #,uiOutput("getSelectedSpecies")
    
    #this doesn't seem to do anything
    #,conditionalPanel( condition = "getSelectedSpecies"
    ,conditionalPanel( condition = TRUE                       
      ,selectInput("variable", "Choose a species :"
                  , choices = "getSelectedSpecies")
      ) #end of conditionalPanel
                        
  ),

  ## MAIN PANEL ##
  mainPanel(
    h4("full species list")
    ,textOutput("caption")
  ) # end of mainPanel  
  
)) #end of ui.R

server.R
library(shiny)

dFSpecies <- data.frame(Name=c("ginkgo","rowan","oak","ash","beech","maple"))


# Define server logic 
shinyServer(function(input, output) {

  #to provide a list of selected species based on input parameters
  #doesn't quite seem to work, may be because shiny doesn't allow
  #return of a dataframe to the UI
  #can return a tagList
  getSelectedSpecies <- reactiveUI(function() {
    
    return(list(dFSpecies$Name[c(1:input$numSpSelected)]))
    
  }) #end of getSelectedSpecies    

  output$speciesSubset <- reactiveUI(function() {
    getSelectedSpecies()  
  })  
 
  # return the full list
  output$caption <- reactiveText(function() {
    as.character(dFSpecies$Name)
  })  
    
}) # end of shinyServer()

#end of server.R

Hi Andy, please see the example on reactiveUI on this page:

http://rstudio.github.com/shiny/tutorial/#dynamic-ui

The selectInput itself must be returned from the reactiveUI function in server.R. The only thing that goes in ui.R is the uiOutput that indicates where in the page the reactiveUI should be rendered.

Hi Winston & Joe,

Many thanks for your replies. I found the example from Winston particularly helpful. I had been through the tutorial for reactiveUI before and not quite been able to transfer it to what I wanted.

Below is the code for my corrected toy example. Now on to implementing something useful !

Best wishes,
Andy 

#ui.r

library(shiny)

# Define UI 
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
  # Application title
  h5("to test populating UI selectInput from server result, Andy South, 17/01/2013"),
  
  # Sidebar with controls 
  sidebarPanel(
    
    sliderInput("numSpSelected", "Top X species", 
                min = 1, max = 6, value = 2, step= 1)

,uiOutput("choose_dataset")
                          
  ), # end of sidebarPanel

## MAIN PANEL ##
  mainPanel(
    h4("full species list :")
    ,textOutput("caption")

,h4("chosen species :")
    ,textOutput("speciesChosenText")

) # end of mainPanel  
  
)) #end of ui.R
#server.r

library(shiny)

dFSpecies <- data.frame(Name=c("ginkgo","rowan","oak","ash","beech","maple"))

# Define server logic 
shinyServer(function(input, output) {

# Drop-down selection box for species
  output$choose_dataset <- reactiveUI(function() {
    
    selectInput("speciesChosen", "Choose a species", choices=getSelectedSpecies())                  
    })
  
  # to provide a list of selected species based on input parameter
  getSelectedSpecies <- function() {  
    
    as.character( dFSpecies$Name[c(1:input$numSpSelected)] )   
  } # end of getSelectedSpecies

# return the full list
  output$caption <- reactiveText(function() {
    
    as.character(dFSpecies$Name)
  })

# return the one selected species
  output$speciesChosenText <- reactiveText(function() {
    
    as.character( input$speciesChosen )

})    
  
}) # end of shinyServer()
#end of server.R
